title: Homology identifications and compatibility for fixed stalk data
statement: The localized presentation complex K supplied by hpres, after taking the stalk at g(a) and transporting scalars along the open-stalk isomorphism, yields the bounded-flat stalk complex P and the derived scalar-extension homology identifications and compatibility.

proof.text: Take exactly K=Classical.choose hpres and the transported termwise stalk P specified in the statement. Unpack choose_spec to get the bound and flatness of K. Zero-morphism preservation of stalks and scalar restriction sends each zero term to zero. Flat stalks are flat over the local ring; a bijective ring map is flat, and Module.Flat.trans transfers flatness through the inverse open-stalk map.
Obtain the universal scalar-extension pair from the existing localization-pair theorem for this P.
In degree n, obtain the open source and target isomorphisms and original-to-local arrow equation, and the generic local-flat-complex counit comparison for K and the chosen pair.

Map the presentation isomorphisms e and t through derived pullback, homology, the local stalk and scalar restriction. Set eL=s followed by the mapped e and l, and eR=r followed by the mapped t and the open target isomorphism. Rewrite by the presentation equation, distribute the functors over composition, substitute the local counit equation, and reassociate. P′=P is rfl; no arbitrary replacement complex is used.

lean.statement:
theorem standardSingleFlatCounit_localization_homology
    (h_affine : ∀ {Y₀ B₀ A₀ : Scheme.{u}} (p₀ : Y₀ ⟶ B₀)
      [QuasiCompact p₀] [QuasiSeparated p₀] [IsAffine B₀] [IsAffine A₀]
      (g₀ : A₀ ⟶ B₀), StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p₀ g₀ ⊤)
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (M : Y.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent] (hM : M.IsFlatOver p) (g : A ⟶ B) (a : A)
    (S : B.Opens) (V : A.Opens) (hS : g a ∈ S) (hV : a ∈ V)
    (hSaff : IsAffine S.toScheme) (hVaff : IsAffine V.toScheme)
    (hVS : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ S)
    (hpres : StandardSingleFlatCounitPresentation (p ∣_ S)
      (M.restrict (p ⁻¹ᵁ S).ι) (g.resLE S V hVS)) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let R := B.presheaf.stalk (g a)
    let T := A.presheaf.stalk a
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} R)
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} T)
    let K := Classical.choose hpres
    let xS : S.toScheme := ⟨g a, hS⟩
    let P :=
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (S.stalkIso xS).inv.hom).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor S.toScheme.toRingedSpace xS).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj K)
    ∃ (P' : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ), P' = P ∧
      (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero (P'.X i)) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Flat R (P'.X i)) ∧
      ∃ (LF : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} T))
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ LF ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars (g.stalkMap a).hom).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hLF : LF.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ))),
        ∀ n : ℤ,
          ∃ (eL : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor A.toRingedSpace a).obj
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
                ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage p).obj
                  ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)))) ≅
              (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
                (LF.obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                  ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P'))))
            (eR : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
                (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj
                  (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (g.stalkMap a).hom).mapHomotopyCategory
                    (.up ℤ)).obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P'))) ≅
              (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor A.toRingedSpace a).obj
                ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj
                  ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd p g)).obj
                    ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
                      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst p g) M))))),
            (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor A.toRingedSpace a).map
                ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).map (standardSingleBaseChangeMap p M g)) =
              eL.hom ≫ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).map
                (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P')) ≫ eR.hom

statement_change.old_statement: For the localized presentation data, fixed P, LF and ε satisfying the bounded-flat and left-derived hypotheses admit all degreewise homology identifications and the required compatibility equality.
statement_change.what: The arbitrary P quantifiers are false: the conclusion must use the complex constructed from the localized presentation witness. This repair constructs P from K := Classical.choose hpres and exposes P' = P.

citers.note: The completion caller is adapted to obtain its P, bounds, and flatness from the repaired theorem.

previous.old_statement: Under the affine open presentation hypothesis, given a bounded-above termwise-flat stalk complex P over the base stalk ring, the derived scalar-extension functor, counit, all homology identifications, and the required compatibility square exist.
previous.what: The old arbitrary-P conclusion is false: identity maps on Spec(k), M=O, P=0 would identify zero with k. Require the actual presentation on affine S and V (including e, t and their equation), not a nonexistent global presentation. Construct P from its K. Parent signature is preserved.
